title: ChronoRoute run manifest, version 1
description: Written next to every set of results by sim/chronoroute/provenance.py (write_manifest). It records how the results were made: commit, config, seeds, orbit snapshot, library versions, host, timing, the output files with their sha256, and the REAL/DERIVED/MODELLED label map. Only a small subset of JSON Schema is used, because the project validates it with its own validator (provenance.SUPPORTED_KEYWORDS); jsonschema is not a dependency.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Bump the trailing number on any incompatible change.

run_id.description: First 16 hex digits of sha256 over the canonical JSON of {config, git_sha, seeds}. The same config and seeds at the same commit always give the same run_id.

tool.description: What produced the run, e.g. python-sim, legacy-python, ns-3, pipeline.

git_sha.description: HEAD commit of the chronoroute repository, or null when the code is not inside a git checkout (or git is missing).

dirty.description: True when the working tree differs from git_sha (tracked or untracked files), ignoring results/ and the run's own declared outputs. Null when git_sha is null.

config.description: The full run configuration exactly as it was hashed.

config_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of config (sorted keys, separators ',' and ':', UTF-8).

seeds.description: Random seeds in the order they were used. Empty for fully deterministic tools.

snapshot.description: The orbit-data snapshot the run used, or null when it used none (e.g. a synthetic Walker shell).

sha256_of.description: Which file the sha256 was computed over, e.g. SHA256SUMS for a data/pinned/ directory.

versions.description: Interpreter and library versions; null means the package is not installed. Tools may add more entries (e.g. ns-3).

host.description: The machine the run executed on. RAM is what the OS reports (inside WSL that is the WSL VM's limit).

started_utc.description: When the run started (from RunTimer), or null if no timer was given.

ended_utc.description: When the run ended (from RunTimer), or null if no timer was given.

wall_seconds.description: Elapsed wall-clock time from a monotonic clock, or null if no timer was given.

outputs.description: Every file the run produced, sorted by path. Paths are POSIX and relative to the directory holding manifest.json.

labels.description: Honesty labels: each named input or quantity is REAL (public/measured data, real physics, or the real output of our code), DERIVED (computed by our code from REAL inputs) or MODELLED (chosen by us because the truth is not public).

extra.description: Tool-specific additions (e.g. ns-3 base SHA, build profile, skipped-satellite counts).
